standing.livesLive: goldens/reading/*.golden.json (R12 revisions append), the sidecars' own logs (LP2), derived-priors/pos-priors + act-priors (each its own checkpoint of a received giver)

proposition.bar: a proposition is a difference that makes a difference — the triadic minimum of assertions: a term, an operator, and the state or ground the move lands against (RULE.md fourth amendment). Rows meet it or fold, disclosed.

posPrior.giver: Universal Dependencies UD_English-EWT, CC BY-SA 4.0 (scripts/build-pos-prior.mjs — ambiguity preserved, no winner picked at build time)
posPrior.mechanism: head extraction is MEASUREMENT, never a list: among a relation's tokens whose UD dominant class is VERB at minShare, the maximal verb share wins (earliest on ties) — aux-capable verbs lose to unambiguous ones by counts alone; unattested tokens are never elected; no VERB-dominant token means no head (the copula rule / no-expectation path)

actExpectations.note: key `${lang}|${form}` — form is the whole relation surface (all languages) or the POS-prior-elected English content head (keyKind on each entry). Every entry carries its hand witness (specimen@ground). CONSUMER RULE: exclude entries whose witness shares the document family under check — self-evidence confirms nothing.
